summary: This is a CI/CD configuration that runs PHP syntax validation on all PHP files in the project. It uses the find command to locate every .php file, then passes each one to PHP's built-in linter to check for syntax errors without actually executing the code.

explanations.3: The find command locates all .php files and outputs them null-terminated (-print0) so spaces in filenames don't break things. xargs -0 reads those null-terminated paths and runs 'php -l' (lint mode) on each file one at a time (-n1) to check for syntax errors.
